units.source_text: 女人回过头来，脸上布满惊恐、警惕的神色。

en.t: The woman turned back, her face filled with fear and wariness.

units.source_text: 谁看了都会觉得，她一定是以那样的表情度过了一生，

en.t: Anyone who saw her would feel that she must have spent her whole life wearing such an expression,

units.source_text: 那哀婉的情绪恰如其分。

en.t: and that sorrowful, plaintive feeling was perfectly fitting.

units.source_text: 于是，男人尽可能装出若无其事的样子，说：

en.t: So the man tried as much as he could to act as if nothing were wrong, and said:
